ground_truth_draft.expected_behavior: Client::set_ssl_verifier must not drop the existing Connector (and its pooled connections / user-supplied settings); it must delegate the verifier into the live connector. To enable this, NetworkConnector gains a required set_ssl_verifier method that Pool/HttpConnector/ConnAdapter all forward.
ground_truth_draft.rationale_from_pr_metadata: Title: 'fix(client): keep the underlying connector when setting an SSL verifier'. Body: 'The client no longer drops the old Connector instance, along with its entire context (such as the settings and pooled connections in the case of a Pool connector); rather, it passes the SSL verifier on to the Connector so that it uses it for any future connections.' Closes #495. Two regression tests assert the old connector is NOT dropped and that set_ssl_verifier is delegated.

ai_baseline.notes: Rank1 nails the new required NetworkConnector method (external_contract). Rank2 (tagged state_transition) accurately describes the connector-discard lifecycle bug — substantively correct mechanism though tag is not lifecycle_ordering. Rank3 is supporting only.
